question: For each academic building in the city of CAMBRIDGE, show the building key, building name, building type, floor key, floor number, and the rank of each floor within its building (ordered by floor number), but only include floors with an assignable area greater than 0. Also, only include buildings that are not the Stata building. Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT 
    b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS building_key,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
    b.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type,
    f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY AS floor_key,
    f.FLOOR AS floor_number,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY f.FLOOR) AS floor_rank
FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ba ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FCLT_FLOOR f ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC'
  AND ba.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE'
  AND b.BUILDING_NAME NOT LIKE '%Stata%'
  AND f.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0
ORDER BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, f.FLOOR
